artworks.title: The Gull Hunter
artworks.description: The image displays bold, angular lines and dark, jagged shapes intersecting in an abstract composition. In the center, there is a reclined figure with outlines and curved forms. Surrounding the figure are abstract shapes resembling stylized plants or leaves, suggesting an outdoor environment. The interplay of black and white emphasizes the contrast and depth within the composition, creating a tranquil yet abstract scene in nature.

artworks.title: Street Scene after the Rain (Straßenszene, Nach dem Regen)
artworks.description: The image displays a series of bold, angular lines and jagged shapes forming an intricate composition. There are curved and straight lines creating an abstract artwork. The shapes resemble a group of people with discernible faces and hats, some holding objects reminiscent of flowers. The figures are set against a backdrop suggesting tree-like forms, with lines crossing and converging, evoking branches and pathways.

artworks.title: Woman with a Veil
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black on blotting paper
artworks.description: The image displays a composition of bold, angular shapes and swirling lines that converge into an abstract portrait. The abstract artwork features a face formed through curved lines and sharp angles, reminiscent of a fragmented mask. The lines and shapes resemble features of a human face like eyes and a mouth, distorted and overlapped in a Cubist interpretation. Elements suggest clothing or a hat through curved and peaked forms, contributing to the abstract theme.

artworks.title: Composer Klemperer
artworks.description: The image consists of sharp, angular lines and intersecting forms that create a chaotic, overlapping pattern. Bold, jagged shapes evoke the silhouette of a face and hands, reminiscent of someone playing a piano. The pointed lines and dark, contrasting areas suggest dynamic movement and energy. The layout and busy intersections of lines give an impression of an intense rhythmic flow, like a musical performance.

artworks.title: Female Nude Before a Cabinet
artworks.description: The image features bold, jagged lines and sharp angles forming an abstract figure. Geometric shapes and outlines suggest a humanoid form in a contemplative stance, with stark contrasts and irregular patterns resembling muscles and bones. The angular shapes may suggest draped cloth or background architecture, creating visual complexity.

artworks.title: Wife of Professor Schaxel
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract composition with bold, jagged lines and sweeping curves that resemble a human face, including eyes, a nose, and disordered hair. Dark and light contrasts add depth, similar to a woodcut technique, highlighting the intense expression present in the image.

artworks.title: Young Woman with a Child (Mädchen mit Kind)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person seated or partially reclined. The person has abstract facial features with large, oval eyes, a triangular nose, and dark, shoulder-length hair. They are wearing a patterned garment with geometric shapes and holding an animal in their arms. To the left, a red plant is depicted with layered, graphic shapes. The background consists of deep blue and brown colors.

artworks.title: The Married Couple Müller (Ehepaar Müller)
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut print depicting two figures in a close-up view, showing their upper bodies and faces. The two individuals appear to be sitting or standing close together in the frame. The person on the left has a slender face with detailed facial features outlined in bold lines, including prominent cheekbones and a small chin. This individual has hair styled into an even parting style that drapes down towards the ears. The person on the right has a more robust face, with a pronounced chin and a mustache, and hair that appears to be closely cropped. Both individuals are wearing dark clothing, possibly suits with visible collars and lapels. The figure on the left is holding an object with elongated fingers pointing. The background consists of a combination of shadows and abstract shapes formed by the contrast of dark and light areas.

artworks.title: Jakob Bosshart: Neben der Heerstrasse (Jakob Bosshart: Near Main Street)
artworks.medium: color woodcut proof on red paper for the dust jacket
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a book cover with a red and black color scheme featuring stylized figures and text. The cover presents a composition of geometric and abstract shapes, alongside blocky, stylized figures. There is an angular design on the top section of the cover, and the title "Neben der Heerstrasse" is displayed in thick, black letters. The full title on the right side reads "Erzählungen von Jakob Bosshart." The style may resonate with early 20th-century graphic design movements.

artworks.title: Smoking Peasant
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in blue and red
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract representation of a seated person. They are sitting cross-legged with one hand on their knee and the other holding a long pipe to their mouth. The person has bold, linear features, including a mustache and beard, and is wearing a hat, vest, and pants. The background has abstract forms resembling mountains and possibly a figure of a barking dog or another person, all depicted with bold red and blue lines in a stylized, expressive manner.

artworks.title: Naked Girl on a Carpet (Nacktes Mädchen auf Teppich)
artworks.description: The image contains bold, angular lines and geometric shapes forming an abstract representation of a human figure with raised arms. The composition is stylized and fragmented, resembling interconnected shapes and lines. The figure is set against intersecting lines and angular patterns, with a smaller abstract figure beside it. Both figures stand on a patterned floor design that mimics tiles or interlocking bricks.

artworks.title: Nude Women with a Child in the Forest
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in dark green, light green and pink

artworks.title: Annette Kolb
artworks.description: The image features a stylized depiction of a person's head and upper torso. The subject faces forward with their head slightly turned to the right. The facial features are abstract, with linear patterns defining the contours of the face. The eyes are wide, the nose is elongated, and the lips are emphasized with dark lines. The person wears a dark hat and a garment with a large white collar. The background is plain, with no distracting elements. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Crane and Barges
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in black, orange and green

artworks.title: Conversation
artworks.description: This is a painting of three abstract figures engaging with each other. The image is composed of bold, black outlines on a light background. The figures are rendered in a stylized manner with exaggerated facial features and gestures. On the left side, two figures appear to be in close conversation, with one whispering to the other. To the right, another figure with a patterned garment seems to be listening or engaging with the first two, with a hand raised. The space is divided with strong lines that suggest a compartmentalized interior with some abstract elements.

artworks.title: Palucca
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in black, green and brown
artworks.description: The image features bold, sweeping lines and angular shapes that form a dynamic figure with exaggerated and elongated limbs. The sharp angles suggest movement, resembling a dancer mid-motion. The figure is shaded with a green hue on the torso and has a patterned ornament on the head. The pose and shapes could be interpreted as reminiscent of a bird in flight or a dancer striking a pose.

artworks.title: Dancer Practicing
artworks.description: The image features bold, flowing lines and shapes creating an abstract composition with figures in dynamic poses. The figures have exaggerated limbs and distorted features and can be connected to familiar objects like human forms in movement or dance. The background uses minimal lines and dots that could resemble a stylized landscape or textured wall.

artworks.title: Woman in the Bathtub
artworks.description: This painting features an abstract composition with geometric shapes and bold lines in the style of Expressionist printmaking. The central figure is created by black lines and shapes against a cream background. The figure appears seated with limbs intertwined. The background contains abstract, angular motifs that complement the figure. At the bottom left, there is a stylized animal form. The use of negative space and simplified forms gives the painting an expressive quality reminiscent of early 20th-century woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Young Girl Drawing
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a person from the shoulders up, depicting slightly more than a head-and-shoulders view. The person is in a downward-facing angle with their head bowed. Their facial features are abstract and stylized, with closed eyes, a long nose, and a contemplative expression. Their hair is stylized with large, swirling forms. They are wearing a garment with a horizontal stripe pattern covering their shoulders and upper arms. Their hands are visible but the details are indistinct. There is no notable jewelry or object. The background is filled with dark cross-hatching and shading, creating depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Dreaming Girl
artworks.description: The artwork shows a full-body sketch of a person lying on their back with slightly bent knees. The person's head is turned to the side with one arm behind their head, displaying facial features like closed eyes and a relaxed expression. The hair seems short and tousled. The person appears unclothed with lines hinting at a blanket or sheets. The background displays a textured surface with pencil or sketch lines, creating an abstract environment around the figure. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Sand Dredgers on the Elbe
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of a structure with a large triangular rooftop in the center. The horizon line is high in the image, showing various smaller structures in the distance. The style is expressive, with bold outlines and cross-hatching creating contrasts between light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, white, and gray. The ground is textured with dark lines, and in the distance, trees and other structures are visible against the sky, creating depth.

artworks.title: Hippodrome
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a circus scene. It shows the interior of a circus tent with a ringmaster or performer leading a horse around the ring. A figure is seated atop the horse wearing a large hat, and another figure stands at the side of the ring. Abstract shapes and lines in the background suggest the presence of an audience. The tent's ceiling is decorated with drapery, creating a festive atmosphere. The drawing style is simple and sketch-like, emphasizing line work to depict movement and form.
